title: Verification ladder (lint → structure → commit), local = CI
acceptance_criteria: shellcheck rung added; passes clean on all 6 scripts (and on `ci.sh` itself)
`ci.sh` reads as an explicit 4-rung fail-fast ladder; verified it stops at rung 1 on a deliberate shellcheck violation
CI runs shellcheck (rung 1 step in ci.yml) so local mirrors CI
Missing shellcheck locally degrades to `sh -n` + install hint (no silent skip)
Ladder + extension point documented (ci.sh header, CONTRIBUTING)
goal: Make doc 02's verification ladder real: ordered, fail-fast, runnable gates that local (`ci.sh`) and CI run identically. Populate with the rungs that apply to a docs/config repo; structure so language rungs (typecheck/unit/e2e) slot in for real repos later.
verification: `shellcheck` clean on all scripts; `ci.sh` green; introduce a deliberate shell bug → ladder fails at rung 1.
notes: shellcheck is the first real "lint" rung. Mirrors doc 02's ladder; the structure is what Track B/C repos inherit.
